definitions.explanation: The garden or yard behind a house, out of sight of the street.

examples.english: We keep a dog in the backyard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏庭|うらにわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother grows vegetables in the back garden.

examples.japanese: {裏庭|うらにわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柿|かき}の{木|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The persimmon tree in the backyard bore lots of fruit again this year.

notes:
⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back) + ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧ (garden, yard).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏庭|うらにわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out into the backyard
- {裏庭|うらにわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物置|ものおき}→物置：17243_monooki⟧: the shed in the backyard
- {裏庭|うらにわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play in the backyard
